prompt:
Phone app screen, portrait 9:16 aspect ratio, flat-on view, no device frame, no browser chrome.

The personal expense tracker's home screen organised as a dense ledger, the numbers themselves doing the talking.

Ground: clean white #FFFFFF, near-black #111827 text, grey #6B7280 secondary.

A header block closed by a hairline rule. Top line: a small grey month label "September 2026" on the left, a small grey count "18 expenses" on the right. Beneath it, the month total at 34 pixel bold with tight letter spacing: "৳ 24,850", and beside it a small green up-arrow with "12% vs August".

Beneath that, five rounded pill chips carrying their amounts inline, each in its own flat pastel: near-black All 24,850; amber Food 10,400; blue Transport 6,000; green Groceries 4,700; purple Health 3,750.

Then a single wide amber strip on pale amber #FDF4E3 with 10 pixel corners: an amber dot, the line "Offline · savings sync when back" in #8A5A12, and right-aligned in the same strip "Saved locally".

Then the ledger itself, edge to edge. Day headers separated from the rows by a hairline rule, each with a bold date on the left and a tabular subtotal on the right: "আজ · Today ৳ 290", "গতকাল · Yesterday ৳ 2,320", "23 September · Wednesday ৳ 340", "22 September · Tuesday ৳ 1,150", "21 September · Monday ৳ 1,890". Expense rows are tight, divided by a very light hairline, and lead with an 8 pixel rounded square of flat category colour instead of an icon. Each row: the square, a merchant name in medium weight with a grey time · category · payment line beneath, and a right-aligned tabular amount. Rows: Biryani House 250, Rickshaw fare 40, Shwapno 1,820, bKash cash out 500, Tea Stall 30, Lazz Pharma 310, Pathao ride 180, Sultan's Dine 620, Kacha Bazar 350, Desco bill 1,890.

Floating bottom-right, clear of every row: one 54 pixel rounded-square blue #2563EB button with 19 pixel corners, a white plus glyph, and a soft blue shadow.

Bengali and Latin text both set cleanly. Flat lighting, no gradients, no glass, no ornament.
